title: RealMint
tagline: RealMint is for minting only Real NFTs! NFTs that do not disappear because the link broke or domain name expired. We empower creators to mint genuine, decentralized NFTs, and raise awareness against faux NFTs using centralized services. These Pseudo NFTs shouldn't exist.
description:
RealMint is a simple easy-to-use tool to mint truly decentralized NFTs. Using its simple interface, users can create their NFTs in just three simple steps:

1. Connect Wallet
2. Upload the Image to IPFS 
3. Confirm the transaction in the wallet to Mint. 

Creators can view all their creations and access the underlying image on IPFS. 

Remember, if it isn't minted with RealMint, it might not be a 'RealNFT'!
how_its_made:
Tools used: 
React js
JavaScript
HTML
CSS
Solidity to write the ERC-721 smart contract
Hardhat
nft.storage to upload to IPFS

Sponsor Technologies used:
Wallet Connect to connect the wallet
nft.storage/Filecoin as a decentralized storage solution for NFTs
Mantle Network to deploy the NFT on the blockchain
